prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.5 °C (31% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.9 °C (25% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.2 °C (21% above healthy). Moderate fluid temperature rise and diminished heat exchange indicate degraded cooler efficiency.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.94 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.0 % (4% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.6 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
